newsitem.title: UK: BLENHEIM SAYS RECEIVED OTHER APPROACHES.
newsitem.headline: BLENHEIM SAYS RECEIVED OTHER APPROACHES.

text.p: Blenheim Group Plc said on Tuesday it had received approaches "which may lead to an offer being made for the whole of the issued share capital of the company".
The group said it was aware of Dutch publisher VNU's interest in it but had not encouraged VNU to buy a 14.99 percent stake.
British exhibition and conference organiser Blenheim said in a statement it was continuing to pursue the other approaches "and a further announcement will be made at the earliest opportunity".
It said that VNU had no current intention of making an offer for the whole company "except that it reserves its position in the event of a full offer being made by a third party".
VNU bought its stake in Blenheim from institutional shareholders at a price of 500 pence per share.
Blenheim shares were quoted at 460-1/2p when the London stock market closed on Tuesday.

"A significant investment in such an exhibitions business is...in line with our long-term strategy of expanding in professional information markets," VNU chairman Bart Brentjens said earlier in a statement.
